test_cases.name: Props Copied Directly into Local useState
test_cases.rationale: Initial state mirroring prop never updates when parent re-renders with new user prop.

test_cases.name: Redundant Derived State Synchronized via useEffect
test_cases.rationale: Storing derived total in state creates extra render cycle and 1-render UI lag.

test_cases.name: Async Typeahead Race Condition Without Request Token
test_cases.rationale: Out-of-order search responses overwrite newer user input results.

test_cases.name: Contradictory Boolean State Flags
test_cases.rationale: Independent boolean state variables allow simultaneous loading and error states.

test_cases.name: Global Store Singleton in SSR Environment
test_cases.rationale: Global module-level store singleton shares user session state across concurrent SSR requests.

test_cases.name: Optimistic Delete Without Rollback on Failure
test_cases.rationale: Optimistic deletion lacks state snapshot rollback when API request fails.

test_cases.name: Unvalidated JSON Parse from LocalStorage
test_cases.rationale: Restoring persisted state without schema validation crashes on legacy version data.

test_cases.name: Uncleaned Subscription with Stale Closure
test_cases.rationale: Missing unsubscribe listener causes memory leak and captures stale initial count variable.

test_cases.name: In-Place Array Mutation Bypassing Change Detection
test_cases.rationale: Directly pushing to state array mutates original reference and prevents component re-render.

test_cases.name: Disjointed State Mutation Bypassing Domain Invariants
test_cases.rationale: Mutating order state across UI helpers without centralized validation allows negative totals.

test_cases.name: Compliant State Management Reference Implementation
test_cases.rationale: Clean implementation using useMemo, AbortController, and immutable state updates.
